integrity: The finite script is a diagnostic; the infinite-dimensional assertions are based on the explicit Fourier Gram and direct-integral proof. Originality is a best-knowledge literature comparison, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Hilbert Paley–Wiener spaces with one symmetric interval, two nonzero opposite modulation frequencies and positive real amplitude only; no claim for more tones, general supports or other Banach exponents.
title: Quantized singular spectra and sharp stability of two-tone Paley–Wiener multipliers
